core_categories: Medical Devices; Dental Equipment; Veterinary Products
specialty_focus: Terumo Australia provides medical technology and device solutions across Australia and New Zealand. It supports clinical practice, hospitals, and specialized medical fields with devices ranging from vascular intervention and cardio-surgical systems to daily clinical disposables. Terumo.com Terumo Australia Pty Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tokyo-based Terumo Corporation , operating as its principal hub in Australia and New Zealand out of Macquarie Park, NSW.
